name: awesome-linux
desc: :penguin: A list of awesome projects and resources that make Linux even more awesome. :penguin:

resources.name: Beautiful Bash: Let's make reading and writing bash scripts fun again!
Best Practices for Writing Bash Scripts
Cinnamon
resources.desc: Strives to provide a traditional user experience.

resources.name: EDE
resources.desc: Small desktop environment built to be responsive, light in resource usage and to have a familiar look and feel.

resources.name: LXQt
resources.desc: Qt port and the upcoming version of LXDE, the Lightweight Desktop Environment. It is the product of the merge between the LXDE-Qt and the Razor-qt projects: A lightweight, modular, blazing-fast and user-friendly desktop environment.

resources.name: MATE
resources.desc: Provides an intuitive and attractive desktop to Linux users using traditional metaphors. Fork of GNOME 2.

resources.name: Pantheon
resources.desc: Pantheon is the default desktop environment originally created for the elementary OS distribution. The desktop has some similarities with GNOME Shell and macOS.

resources.name: 9wm
resources.desc: Window manager that attempts to emulate the Plan 9 window manager 8-1/2 as far as possible within the constraints imposed by X.

resources.name: awesome
resources.desc: Highly configurable window manager for X. Fast and extensible.

resources.name: Blackbox
resources.desc: Lightweight window manager for the X window system, without library dependencies. Built using C++.

resources.name: bspwm
resources.desc: Tiling window manager that represents windows as the leaves of a full binary tree.

resources.name: Compiz
resources.desc: OpenGL compositing window manager. It has a plug-in system to be changed at runtime.

resources.name: dwm
resources.desc: Dynamic window manager for X. It manages windows in tiled, monocle and floating layouts. All of the layouts can be applied dynamically, optimising the environment for the application and task performed.

resources.name: Enlightenment
resources.desc: Window manager bundled with a whole suite of libraries to help you create beautiful user interfaces.

resources.name: Fluxbox
resources.desc: Window manager for X, lightweight and easy to handle but full of features to make an easy and fast desktop experience. Built using C++.

resources.name: FVWM
resources.desc: ICCCM-compliant multiple virtual desktop window manager for X. Extremely powerful.

resources.name: i3
resources.desc: Tiling window manager. BSD-licensed. Primarily targeted at advanced users and developers.

resources.name: IceWM
resources.desc: Window manager with the goal of being fast, simple, and not getting in the user's way.

resources.name: JWM
resources.desc: Lightweight window manager for X11. Good choice for older and/or less powerful systems, though perfectly capable of running on modern systems. Built using C.

resources.name: Matchbox
resources.desc: Environment for X running on non-desktop embedded platforms such as handhelds, set-top boxes, kiosks and anything else for which screen space, input mechanisms or system resources are limited.

resources.name: Mutter
resources.desc: Window manager for X. Default window manager in GNOME 3.

resources.name: Openbox
resources.desc: Highly configurable window manager with extensive standards support.

resources.name: ratpoison
resources.desc: A simple window manager with no library dependencies, no graphics, and no decorations. Modeled after GNU Screen.

resources.name: Sawfish
resources.desc: Extensible window manager. Its aim is to manage windows in the most flexible and attractive manner possible. Built using Lisp-based scripting language.

resources.name: wmii
resources.desc: Small, scriptable window manager, with a 9P filesystem interface and an acme-like layout.

resources.name: xmonad
resources.desc: Dynamically tiling X11 window manager. Makes work easier by automating aligning and searching for windows. Built using Haskell.

resources.name: Builder
resources.desc: IDE for GNOME that is focused on bringing the power of the GNOME platform to more developers.

resources.name: Evince
resources.desc: The most popular document viewer on the GNOME platform.

resources.name: Gedit
resources.desc: Powerful general purpose text editor.

resources.name: Polari
resources.desc: IRC client built to be easy to use.

resources.name: To Do
resources.desc: Minimalistic personal task manager designed to fit right into your GNOME desktop.

resources.name: FeedReader
resources.desc: RSS desktop client able to integrate with multiple online services.

resources.name: Go For It!
resources.desc: To-do list with built-in productivity timer.

resources.name: NaSC
resources.desc: Intelligent calculator app.

resources.name: Spice-Up
resources.desc: Desktop presentation app.

resources.name: Vocal
resources.desc: Podcast client for the modern desktop.

resources.name: Dolphin
resources.desc: File manager for KDE focusing on usability.

resources.name: Krita
resources.desc: Painting program.

resources.name: Atom
resources.desc: Hackable text editor for the 21st century.
resources.section: Not based on any desktop environment

resources.name: ghostwriter
resources.desc: Distraction-free Markdown editor.
resources.section: Not based on any desktop environment

resources.name: GParted
resources.desc: The most popular disk partitioning software out there.
resources.section: Not based on any desktop environment

resources.name: Kodi
resources.desc: Most popular entertainment center.
resources.section: Not based on any desktop environment

resources.name: Zathura
resources.desc: Highly customizable document viewer. It provides a minimalistic and space saving interface as well as an easy usage that mainly focuses on keyboard interaction.
resources.section: Not based on any desktop environment

resources.name: Etcher
resources.desc: Flash OS images to SD cards and USB drives, safely and easily.
resources.section: Not based on any desktop environment

resources.name: Corebird
resources.desc: Twitter client.

resources.name: GNOME Twitch
resources.desc: Twitch player.

resources.name: Caprine
resources.desc: Facebook's Messenger client with some added privacy features.

resources.name: PB for Desktop
resources.desc: Pushbullet client.

resources.name: ramme
resources.desc: Instagram client.

resources.name: Whatever
resources.desc: Evernote client based on the web version.

resources.name: AppImageKit
resources.desc: Using AppImageKit you can package applications in the AppImage format that runs on common Linux-based operating systems, such as RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Fedora, debian and derivatives; one app = one file.

resources.name: cmus
resources.desc: Small, fast and powerful console music player.

resources.name: fuck
resources.desc: Command line tool which corrects your previously mistyped command.

resources.name: git
resources.desc: Distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed and efficiency.

resources.name: glances
resources.desc: Cross-platform system monitoring tool.

resources.name: htop
resources.desc: Nice looking, customizable task manager.

resources.name: nano
resources.desc: Simple to use text editor.

resources.name: photorec
resources.desc: Useful tool for restoring deleted files.

resources.name: ranger
resources.desc: Vim-inspired file manager for the console.

resources.name: screenFetch
resources.desc: Fetches system/theme information in terminal.

resources.name: shellcheck
resources.desc: Static analysis tool for shell scripts.

resources.name: speed-test
resources.desc: Test your Internet connection speed and ping using speedtest.net.

resources.name: testdisk
resources.desc: A tool for disk partition recovery.

resources.name: tig
resources.desc: Text-mode interface for git. It functions mainly as a Git repository browser.

resources.name: vim
resources.desc: Advanced text editor that seeks to provide the power of the de-facto Unix editor 'Vi', with a more complete feature set.

resources.name: vtop
resources.desc: Easily-extendable activity monitor.

resources.name: wavemon
resources.desc: Monitoring application for wireless network devices.

resources.name: youtube-dl
resources.desc: A tool to download videos from YouTube and other video sites.
